claims.quote: Described from 'Merauke, Irian Jaya, Indonesia' which corresponds to modern day Merauke Regency, Papua province, Indonesia, on the island of New Guinea.

It's distributed along a relatively short section of New Guinea's southern coast, between Merauke and the mouth of the Fly River across the border in Papua New Guinea, and in the latter watershed has been recorded over 500 km inland.
In Australia records exist from numerous river basins of the Cape York Peninsula, Queensland state, plus the Northern Territory to the west, including the Arafura wetland in Arnhem Land.
Iriatherina werneri is native to tropical Australia and Papua New Guinea.
